description: Editable starter profile for creating a new WWE 2K26 Luchador Mask mapping profile. Copy this file, rename the profile_id/display_name, adjust zones and rules, then add the new JSON filename to profiles.json. The zones below intentionally mirror generic_hood_wrap_v1 until a real custom mapping is measured.

logic_grid.range_rule: Column and row ranges are inclusive logical ranges.
logic_grid.notes: 128 x 128 normalized lmask-layout grid. Each cell is exactly 16 px on a 2048 x 2048 texture.

coordinate_rules.clamp_rule: Clamp final end values to canvasSize - 1 so calculated pixels never exceed canvas bounds.

front_center.purpose: Strongest central front identity balance zone.

forehead_identity.purpose: Forehead emblem, controlled skull centerpiece, or front identity.

left_eye_surround.purpose: Raised trim around left eye zone.

right_eye_surround.purpose: Raised trim around right eye zone.

cheek_jaw_overall.purpose: Overall cheek and jaw flow zone.

left_cheek_jaw.purpose: Left cheek and jaw panel flow.

right_cheek_jaw.purpose: Right cheek and jaw panel flow.

chin_lower_mouth.purpose: Chin plate and lower mouth identity.

must: Paint directly onto the full square canvas.
Use the profile zones for element placement.
Keep eye surrounds in mapped eye zones.
Keep cheek and jaw panels flowing downward from the eye zones.
Keep chin/mouth identity in the lower center zone.
Wrap side panels outward from the cheek/jaw zones.
Keep rear seam dark and simple.
Keep top/crown broad, dark, and simple.
Use full square texture canvas only.
Use 2048 x 2048 as the default production canvas unless another size is explicitly selected.
Use the 128 x 128 layout/grid references for placement accuracy.
Do not copy guide colors, labels, or grid lines into final mask_color.png.
avoid: Do not create a UV island sheet.
Do not create a cutout mask template.
Do not create a blue grid.
Do not create a debug coordinate layout.
Do not show labels, boxes, or numbers in final output.
Do not place major logos, text, skulls, or faces on rear seam.
Do not place circular emblems on top/back seam.
Do not cut literal transparent eye holes.
Do not make a front-view product render.
Do not make a concept sheet or turnaround sheet during Stage 2.

example_note: Do not treat this as a separate verified game profile until you replace the copied zones with tested mapping data.
layout_reference_usage: Upload the layout reference PNG with the final handoff prompt and profile JSON. It is a placement guide only, not final art. Use the 128 x 128 technical grid for exact placement correction; each cell is 16 px on a 2048 texture.
